verdict.rationale: Phone integration, such as mirroring or controlling a phone from the desktop, is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no phone mirroring or phone control feature. The documented remote-desktop sharing and access features cover other computers, not phones, so they are an adjacent capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can view and control my phone directly from my desktop
